summary: Mobile View: Part Number is not appearing in the Work Order instead it shows Part Description.
reported_issue: On the Work Order parts display, the Part Number was not appearing for the main part; only the Part Description was shown. (Core part already showed its part number.)
expected_after_fix: The Part number and Description should both appear for the main part (as already worked for the core part).
steps_i_followed: Opened Work Order S9-24674 (has 2 part lines with part number N68SL-356) as admin.
Desktop: Lines tab -> inspected the parts under line 1.
Mobile (390x844 iPhone emulation): opened the same WO -> Parts (2) sub-tab and inspected the Description vs Part Number columns.
actual_now: Desktop Lines view shows each part as '(N68SL-356) 3.50-3.82" ... SPRING LOADED T-BOLT CLAMP' for both the main part and its core - part number is prefixed and the description follows. Mobile Parts sub-tab shows a dedicated 'Part Number' column populated with N68SL-356 (and 'SPO REGRESS') separate from the 'Description' column for both main and core parts.
notes: Verified on both desktop and mobile viewports. Part number is present for the main part in both layouts. Mobile screenshot at /tmp/cln/SV-5128_mobile_parts.png also confirms a distinct populated Part Number field.
